# pr-1726: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans

## Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# pr-1726: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans

## Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group

- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

# pr-1726: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans

## Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23

- **Deletions**: -145

- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726

- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. # Pull Request Information

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

# pr-1726: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans

## Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1726
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1726
- **Title**: fix: goal_builder resume — hidden-checkpoint estimator parity, instant over-window boot cap, wake gate, tail-capped boot scans
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23
- **Additions**: +945
- **Deletions**: -145
- **Created**: 2026-10-20T18:32:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-20T18:38:55Z

## PR Description

## The goal_builder incident (owner-reported)

Reopening the `goal_builder` marathon session (2.7GB JSONL) was slow (30s–3.5min), showed a jumping ctx meter (72% → 21%), and historically dead-ended in an over-window boot loop with endless compaction.

## Root causes found (all reproduced on the real session)

1. **Hidden-checkpoint estimator parity** — when structured compaction hides a `CompactCheckpointRecord` itself, `projection.dart _coverAt` renders its whole span FULL, but both estimators (`estimateProjectedBranchTokens`, `projectedBranchBudgetCut`) still credited its covers: the file priced ~175k while the real request carried ~298k. The resume budget trim never fired → over-window boot → compaction loop. Estimators now mirror the projection exactly (hidden checkpoint covers nothing, renders no marker).
2. **Over-window resume boots instantly** — `_capResumedContext` now applies the `localTrimValve` immediately when the resumed transcript exceeds the window (an LM pass there took minutes on slow summarizers and read as a hung open). Over-trigger-under-window keeps the LM boot cap (gh-1425 contract).
3. **Boot-race wake gate** — `_sessionLoadsInFlight` gates inbox/steering wakes while a marathon load walks: a wake run against the half-loaded agent died on the over-window guard before the boot cap could run.
4. **2.7GB primary scan on the boot path** — the windowed storage never rotates, so the orphan-report seed (`lastSegmentOnly`) and the steering/obligations/registry scans read the whole giant from offset 0 (~12–30s of every open). `readCustomRecordsOfType` now tail-caps each file at `kSessionSegmentHardCapBytes` (all consumers are tail consumers); deep-history callers pass `tailCapBytes: null`.

## Measured on the real 2.7GB session (headless probe)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| open → first turn start | ~31–32s | **3.7s** |
| full probe run (boot + 174k prefill + answer) | 1m51s | ~7s (prefill rides the provider cache afterwards) |
| bogus compaction at open | yes (meter jumps, boot cap churn) | none (174k < 183k trigger — correctly skipped) |

## Tests

- `test/compaction/token_estimation_test.dart` — hidden-checkpoint parity group
- `test/cli/agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` — instant-trim boot (0 LM calls), degraded summarizer, crashed-report backstop, stale-abort
- `test/cli/agent_cli_inbox_wake_test.dart` — wake defers while a session load is in flight
- `test/session/custom_record_tail_cap_test.dart` — tail-capped raw scans

Plus a drive-by: macOS FSEvents flake fix in `config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (late replay of save #1's tmp-file events blamed save #2; CI/Linux never saw it).

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `fix/goalbuilder-resume-speed` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 23

- **Deletions**: -145
